about_the_game:
————The story begins:

Daji curled up in the corner of the dilapidated temple, and the jade pendant in her arms suddenly became hot. That is a broken jade plaque engraved with the character "Jian". Whenever the moon is full, it always reflects the phantom image of Yang Jian wielding his sword. Thunder exploded outside the temple, and a three pointed, two bladed knife pierced through the door panel. Yang Jian shattered talismans all over the ground, and a cold light shone from his forehead as he said, "Demons, we're not going to be executed yet

Do you still remember who held the other half of this jade plaque? "Daji touched the crack on the jade plaque with her fingertips, revealing a fiery birthmark on her neck that was identical to Yang Jian's. Yang Jian's pupils suddenly shrank, and the blade was slightly off center, shattering her hair by the ear. A cold laugh came from the darkness, and Jiang Ziya walked out slowly with the help of a divine whip. The apricot yellow flag fluttered at his waist, and half a jade plaque with the character "Jiang" hung prominently. ​

The torrential rain poured down, and Daji's fox tail meandered in the mud and water. She suddenly coughed up black blood, and the blood droplets fell to the ground, turning into a series of Manzhu Shahua, perfectly overlapping with the dark patterns on Jiang Ziya's Taoist robe. Do you remember for whom the Prime Minister blocked the calamity of heaven when he cut off his heart? "Daji laughed bitterly, her nails brushing against Jiang Ziya's wrist, revealing the same burn marks as her palm - the marks left by fox fire thousands of years ago. ​

The howling dog suddenly started barking uncontrollably, and Yang Jian's heavenly eyes flashed with unfamiliar memories: the fox demon cub was chased by heavenly soldiers, and the little Taoist who was covered in blood risked his life to save it; In the alchemy room, the girl stuffed her own life demon pill into the mouth of a severely injured Taoist. Impossible... "Yang Jian stumbled backwards, his three pointed, two bladed knife slamming to the ground. ​

Jiang Ziya suddenly swung his whip around Daji, and the apricot yellow flag enveloped her. The nine tailed fox embroidered on the flag is lifelike, and the tail tip is wrapped around the wrist guard that Yang Jian wears all year round. Back then, you and I teamed up to set up a plan, just to keep her soul alive, "Jiang Ziya whispered to the shocked Yang Jian, while Daji showed a sly smile in the golden light - her jade hairpin hidden in her sleeve was slowly piercing into Jiang Ziya's heart, and the phoenix totem on the jade hairpin was no different from the artifact of a certain immortal E under the throne of Yuanshi Tianzun. ​

In the thunderous light, the shadows of the four people twisted and overlapped. The birthmark on Daji's neck suddenly turned into a chain, entangling Yang Jian and Jiang Ziya at the same time. The shattered jade plaque reassembles in the air, reflecting a scene from thousands of years ago: the demon fox and the fairy child secretly commit to a lifetime, but are surrounded by the heavenly court. In order to protect their loved ones, the fairy child destroys their original spirit and seals a strand of their remaining soul in the fox pill

————Character background relationship:

Misplaced emotions in past and present lives:

Daji and Yang Jian were once lovers in their previous lives, but due to their fairy and demon identities and fate, they had opposing positions in the Battle of Sealing the Gods. Yang Jian personally "killed" Daji. Meeting again in this life, although Yang Jian has lost the memories of his past life, he is unconsciously attracted to Daji; Daji, with the love, hate, and obsession of her past life, faced the familiar and unfamiliar Yang Jian, and her emotions were repeatedly torn between revenge, attachment, and unwillingness.

The hidden surge of taboo master disciple love:

Jiang Ziya, as Yang Jian's master, has complex emotions towards him that surpass those of a master disciple. On the one hand, he hoped that Yang Jian would uphold his mission of slaying demons and eliminating evil spirits, but on the other hand, he felt jealous and uneasy because he noticed Yang Jian's special feelings for Daji. This subtle emotion made Jiang Ziya appear contradictory and conflicted when dealing with the relationship between Daji and Yang Jian, even resorting to extreme measures.

The sadness of unrequited love and guardianship:

Xiaotian Dog has a deep attachment and loyalty to Yang Jian, which goes beyond ordinary servant relationships. It witnessed Yang Jian's attitude towards Daji changing, both worried that Yang Jian would be confused by Daji and afraid of losing Yang Jian's attention. Xiaotian Dog silently guards Yang Jian, but can only bury the bitter unrequited love deep in his heart and stand up for Yang Jian at critical moments.

The contradiction between the stance of immortals and demons and the mission of the family:

Daji, as a fox demon, bears the mission of reviving the demon race; Jiang Ziya and Yang Jian are representatives of upholding the Way of Heaven and eliminating demons and monsters. The affection that arose between Daji and Yang Jian clashed fiercely with their respective positions and missions. Yang Jian struggles between emotions and responsibilities, while Daji also faces a difficult choice between love and ethnic interests. This contradiction will continue to intensify their emotional entanglement.

The interweaving of sympathy and love hate between archenemies:

Daji and Jiang Ziya had a hostile relationship in the War of Sealing the Gods, and both had caused significant damage to each other. However, in the new story, as they get to know each other and get to know each other better, they discover that the other person has traits they admire, creating subtle emotional changes between hatred and appreciation. This complex emotion can make their scenes full of tension.

————Game storyline:

The plot unfolded after the story of Fengshen Bang. Surrounding many characters such as Daji, Jiang Ziya, Erlang Shen, etc.

————Gameplay:

Plot twists and turns: The game plot is full of ups and downs, with 3-10 hours of plot and main quests, full of suspense, horror, and twists.

Card turn combat: Players use strategic combinations of cards to engage in turn based battles against enemies. By properly pairing your own heroes, achieve double the effect!

Random function on the battlefield: Lucky bosses, item stores, lottery opportunities, and monsters of different levels randomly appear on the battlefield, adding game variables. Every time we choose a forward route, it is also a measure of our combat strategy.

Hero Recruitment: Players can recruit various heroes to expand their combat team.

Hero Enhancement: Enhance hero abilities through upgrades, equipment, and other means to make them stronger.

Hero Team: Players can freely combine hero combinations to leverage the advantages of team collaboration in combat.

Hero Returning: Unsatisfied heroes can be reheated to retrain or acquire resources.

Heroic cultivation: A specially designed dual cultivation system with female heroes to enhance the understanding and strength between heroes.

Rich rewards after winning: After winning, players can receive a large number of rewards to help their characters grow.

Purchasing and selling resources: Players can freely buy and sell resources within the game, optimizing resource allocation.

Multiple dungeons can be unlocked: As the game progresses, players can unlock multiple dungeons to experience different challenges and fun

————Game objectives

Unlock new storylines through battles and advance the overall development of the story content. In the end, you will challenge the ultimate enemy. If the challenge is successful, you can complete the overall plot and story content. Of course, this is not the final result, you can also repeat the story content and challenge stronger enemies. Complete the high-level challenge objectives.

content_descriptors.notes: Some female characters in the game have revealing clothing. Having sexy movements or dances
